preconditions.description: The length of the sequence is between 1 and 10^5.
The elements of sequences a and b are in the range from l to r.
The elements of sequence a are within the range from l to r.
The elements of the compressed sequence p are distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output is list and len(output) == n)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a list of n integers.

postconditions.expression: any(b_i - a_i == c_i for b_i, c_i in zip(output, c))
postconditions.description: For any i, b_i - a_i equals c_i where c_i is the i-th element of the sequence c.

postconditions.expression: all(p_i == sum(1 for c_j in c if c_j <= p_i) for p_i in p)
postconditions.description: The compressed sequence p is correctly calculated from the sequence c.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or all(b_i != b_j for i, b_i in enumerate(output) for j, b_j in enumerate(output) if i != j)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, all elements of the sequence b are distinct.
